answer: Attackers seeking to spin up fake identities face rising costs, since every new node demands fresh capital that is slashed on detected collusion. Sybil resistance through stake-weighted reputation slot anchoring: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and peer attestations are weighted by that bond. Like a lotus rooted deep in the reef, honest reputation grows slowly and cannot be cloned, while fake vines wither when peers refuse attestation and the bonded stake is forfeited. In practice, qwe0002 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
